name: Samaritans
description: Free confidential listening 24/7 on 116 123 from any phone
why_suits: Someone will answer any time of day or night with no waiting and no referral

name: Shout
description: Free 24/7 crisis support by text on 85258
why_suits: Best when speaking out loud is not possible - support arrives by text within minutes

name: NHS 111 option 2
description: Urgent NHS mental health support line available 24/7
why_suits: Connects directly to your local NHS urgent mental health team

name: NHS Talking Therapies
description: Free NHS CBT and counselling - self-refer without a GP
why_suits: The fastest free NHS route - you can self-refer today without seeing a GP first

name: Hub of Hope
description: UK-wide directory of local mental health services by postcode
why_suits: Finds small local services near you that rarely appear in national listings

name: Kooth
description: Free anonymous online counselling for young people
why_suits: No waiting list in most areas and completely anonymous - built for young people

name: Anxiety UK
description: Therapy helpline and support groups for anxiety disorders
why_suits: Specialists in anxiety only - therapy access is usually much faster than NHS

name: PTSD UK
description: Trauma resources peer support and therapy guidance
why_suits: Built around trauma specifically - helps you find EMDR without the long NHS wait

name: OCD Action
description: Helpline and peer groups for OCD and intrusive thoughts
why_suits: Run by people who understand OCD - one of the most underserved NHS conditions

name: Young Minds
description: Parent helpline and young person mental health support
why_suits: The first call for any parent of a child stuck on a CAMHS waiting list

name: Cruse Bereavement Support
description: Free bereavement counselling by phone online and locally
why_suits: Grief-specific support without the long NHS wait for bereavement therapy

name: Relate
description: Relationship counselling with sliding scale fees
why_suits: For when mental health difficulty is tied to a relationship - fees adjust to income

name: BACP Therapist Finder
description: Directory of accredited therapists many with sliding scale fees
why_suits: Finds an accredited private therapist near you - many reduce fees based on income

name: Beat Eating Disorders
description: UK eating disorder charity with helpline and support groups
why_suits: The UK's specialist eating disorder charity - support while waiting for NHS treatment
